The '''RG-9 laser cannon''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was manufactured by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] utilized these weapons aboard their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].
